Product analytics without the warehouse

Bramble Analytics gives small product teams funnels, retention curves and session replay without asking them to run a data warehouse first. You drop in one script, and the questions a product manager actually asks are answerable on the same afternoon.

We serve teams of between three and fifty people who have outgrown their spreadsheet but cannot justify a data engineer. Everything is priced per tracked user and there is a free tier that does not expire.
